jobs.title: Automation Engineer, 80-100%
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind die Veratron AG - ein weltweit operierendes Entwicklungs- und Produktionsunternehmen, welches seit dem Jahr 1972 anspruchsvolle und innovative Instrumentierungen für Fahrzeuge aller Art vertreibt. Angefangen mit Geschwindigkeits- und Drehzahlmessern für Personenwagen über Motorrad- und Fahrradtachos, Sensoren, Steuermodule und weitere spannende Produkte ist die Veratron AG heute das Kompetenzzentrum für Elektronik-Systeme mit Schwerpunkt auf den Märkten Sonderfahrzeuge und Freizeitschifffahrt.

In einem kleinen, engagierten Team arbeitest du hands-on an der Entwicklung moderner Softwarelösungen, die direkt in unseren Produktions- und Prüfanlagen eingesetzt werden. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbaren Einfluss auf unsere Fertigungsprozesse – von der ersten Idee über die Konzeption bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Lösungen. Wir bieten dir Gestaltungsspielraum für deine fachliche und kreative Entfaltung, kurze Entscheidungswege sowie ein hohes Mass an Eigenverantwortung. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie softwaregestützte Produktionslösungen bei uns entstehen und wachsen.

YOUR PLAYGROUND

  • Du entwickelst Softwarelösungen für unsere Produktions- und Prüfanlagen im Bereich Production Engineering

  • In deiner Rolle planst und realisierst du Projekte im Betriebsmittelbau, von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung (inkl. Bestellungen) und Inbetriebnahme

  • Bestehende Prozesse und Softwarelösungen betreust, wartest und entwickelst du kontinuierlich weiter – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion und Engineering

  • Du stellst den Betrieb sowie die Wartung produktionsnaher Datennetzwerke und Server sicher

  • Die fachliche Unterstützung und das Coaching von Informatik-Lernenden gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Aufgabenbereich


YOUR PROFILE

kreativ innovativ mutig / offen für Neues / lösungsorientiert / bodenständig / selbstständig / eigenverantwortung

  • Eine technische Grundausbildung, ergänzt durch eine weiterführende Aus- oder Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF oder FH (abhängig von Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung), bildet deine Basis

jobs.title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
jobs.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes.
  • Technical Excellence. Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. 
  • Manufacturing Instinct. Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors.
  • End-to-End Ownership. Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • Maniacal Urgency. Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it.
  • People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.


Apply

Resume: Focus on geometry systems you've built and owned.
GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hard problem you solved - code, papers, or parts that came off a machine because of you.
Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

Your role with us

As Senior Platform Engineer, you own the platform that Workist's AI agents run on: two clouds, the Kubernetes clusters for production, staging and ML workloads, and the path from merge request to production for every service we ship. You decide how this platform evolves, you keep it secure, observable and cost-efficient, and you extend it as the product grows. Most recently that meant an LLM gateway with region failover in front of our Azure OpenAI deployments, and performing GPU capacity planning for our own models.

You set your own roadmap. Infrastructure at Workist is run as quarterly themes that you propose, make the case for and deliver, and roughly a third of your time goes to whatever the week brings: an incident, a pentest finding, a developer whose deployment is stuck and needs a second pair of eyes. You report to our CTO and are the voice of the platform in engineering decisions.


How we build and run things

  • Everything runs on Kubernetes (Azure AKS), deployed with Helm and GitOps/Flux. All infrastructure is Terraform, applied through CI.

  • CI/CD for every service on GitLab

  • Managed services wherever they keep life simple: Postgres, OpenSearch, Redis, blob storage. We self-host only where it clearly pays off.

  • Two clouds: Azure as our primary cloud, AWS for search and mail ingestion.

  • Python everywhere: read and fix application code when that is where the fix belongs.

  • Security is routine: automated scanning in every pipeline, regular external pentests, quarterly backup and disaster-recovery tests.

  • Own the architecture of our cloud environments across Azure and AWS: how subscriptions, networks, identities and environments are structured and stay isolated

  • Design and deliver the platform capabilities the product needs next, from GPU capacity and an LLM gateway to new environments

  • Own observability and alerting so that every alert is worth acting on, and lead the response to platform incidents including the follow-up fixes

  • Run quarterly backup/restore and disaster-recovery tests, and close what they reveal

Make the team faster

What this looked like recently: a Redis instance that silently dropped half of its new TCP connections and took the Celery workers down with it, region failover and load balancing for our Azure OpenAI deployments, moving our clusters from nginx ingress to the Kubernetes Gateway API.


Your profile

  • You have run production infrastructure for years, ideally as the person who owned it end to end rather than one of many in a large ops team

Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by over $55 million from top-tier investors like Sequoia Capital, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

An AI agent that runs a property transaction end to end only works if the data underneath it is available, reliable and governed. That is the job.

Why this role exists

This is the first dedicated data hire in years. The foundations run, the steering is up to you.

While BigQuery already houses most of our data, we still lack key Growth data and a cohesive data governance framework. We need unified definitions, a canonical schema, and a robust semantic layer, enabling Growth, Finance, Ops and Product to self-serve insights efficiently and reliably.

Today the stack holds because individuals across Ops, Growth, Finance and Engineering compensate locally. They learned the quirks and built workarounds. It works, but it is fragile: KPIs drift between tools, tracking breaks silently, costs escalate, and nobody owns the translation between raw engineering data and decision-ready truth.

You will be the single accountable owner of that layer. Not a support function, not a ticketing desk, not a BI factory.

What you will own

Canonical models and metric definitions. A documented semantic layer with canonical entities (Buyer, Seller, Asset, Agent) and Bronze / Silver / Gold layers. Clear contracts between what Engineering exposes and what each function consumes, so that KPI debates are aligned on the same metric.

Self-serve enablement. The submerged part of the iceberg: clean models, consistent BI primitives, row- and column-level security, so Ops, Growth, Finance and Account Managers build their own dashboards without compromising on accuracy.

Analytics and tracking governance. The global event taxonomy and tracking roadmap, a hybrid client-side and server-side event strategy, consistent sync across CRMs and marketing platforms, and GDPR consent flows by design, so acquisition spend runs on attribution we can trust.

Platform reliability, safety and cost. Standards set once rather than team by team: tested and versioned transformations, monitoring of freshness, failures and usage, sane ingestion patterns (read replicas, CDC, batch), and no production code path depending on BI tables.

Data and AI driving decisions. Our internal AI tooling already queries the data warehouse for analyses. What’s missing is the core foundation: standardized metric definitions, reusable logic, and pre-computed data models.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • One documented event taxonomy, actually used by Engineering, Growth and CRM.

  • One semantic layer where every shared KPI has a single definition, a single owner and a version history. New joiners understand the data model in days, not months.

  • Published freshness and failure SLAs, an explicit ingestion topology, and no production path depending on BI tables.

  • Ops, Growth, Finance and AMs build most of their recurring dashboards themselves, and AI agents query the data layer safely through curated MCPs.

  • Growth attribution is trustworthy enough that annual acquisition spend decisions are defensible end to end.

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years as a Data, Analytics or Platform Engineer, ideally including a stint at a fast-moving consumer or marketplace company. Staff or Lead exposure expected.

  • Hands-on with the modern data stack: BigQuery (or Snowflake, Redshift), dbt or equivalent, advanced SQL and data modeling, Python for pipelines, orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).

  • You have shipped event tracking and instrumentation in production, end to end: taxonomy, client and server-side events, attribution, GDPR-compliant opt-out, propagation downstream.

  • Comfortable with ingestion patterns (Fivetran, Airbyte, CDC), reverse-ETL (Hightouch, Census, Segment), and access governance (IAM, row- and column-level security, PII tagging).

  • You have built and owned a semantic or metrics layer, and you can arbitrate metric definitions with Finance, Ops and Growth without flinching.

  • You treat AI agents as first-class data consumers: exposing data through MCPs, semantic APIs or text-to-SQL, with proper guardrails.

  • Strong ownership: you write the standards, defend them, and fix what is broken without waiting for permission.

  • A clear communicator who turns "ping the data person" rituals into self-serve handoffs.

jobs.description:
Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

About the company

The transition to a sustainable future requires discovering new mineral resources to power clean technologies and renewable energy solutions. From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition.

Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. Based in Paris, Lithosquare gathered an exceptional team of geologists, scientists, AI engineers, and data specialists to work as one, from field sampling to model optimization and push the boundaries of what's possible.

About the job

As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio.

This is a dynamic, cross-functional role: you will divide your time between field work (reconnaissance, sampling, drilling support) and office work in Paris, working closely with senior geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers. We are looking for someone rigorous, curious about technological innovation, and eager to learn while helping build the next generation of AI-assisted exploration tools.

What you'll do

Reporting to the Senior Geologists and the VP Asset Development, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Field Execution & Support: Support and participate in all phases of field exploration programs, including regional reconnaissance, surface sampling, geophysical surveys, and drilling campaigns. Assist with field logistics while ensuring compliance with international health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.

  • Data Compilation & QA/QC: Lead geological data entry, compilation, and QA/QC processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of exploration datasets across all projects.

  • Office Work: Assist senior geologists with geological data interpretation to support exploration targeting, field campaign planning, technical reporting, GIS mapping, data management, and project evaluation. Contribute to the preparation of maps, presentations, and technical documentation.

  • Bridge Geology & AI Tech: Work closely with the tech and AI teams to test, refine, and improve Lithosquare’s AI platform, ensuring our digital tools reflect field realities and technical needs.

  • Reporting & Collaboration: Prepare clear technical summaries, data visualizations, and maps for internal reviews and partner updates.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in mineral exploration geology

  • Degree in Geology or Earth Sciences, with solid foundations in metallogeny, structural geology, or geochemistry

  • First significant field exposure (mapping, sampling, or core logging) with a willingness to spend significant time in the field as required by projects

  • Data-driven & Rigorous: A structured approach to data management, QA/QC, and documentation; familiarity with GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS) and/or geological modeling software is a plus

  • Tech-curious & Innovative mindset: Genuine interest in how AI and technology can transform traditional exploration methods

  • Strong Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary team (geologists, data scientists, AI engineers), interact professionally with partners and produce clear, synthetic & high-quality deliverables

  • Mission-driven: Passionate about the energy transition and solving complex physical-world challenges through innovation

  • Fluency in English is required with previous exposure to international exchanges

  • Valid Driver's License (Permis B) is a bonus

Perks & Benefits

  • 🏢 Offices located in the heart of Paris

  • 🌱 Strong culture of ownership & entrepreneurship

  • 🌍 Opportunity to significantly contribute to energy transition

  • 👥 Collaborative work environment with world-class experts in geology, AI, and data science

  • 🏋️ Gym pass

jobs.description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

Location: Hybrid from Paris or full remote

Role Overview

ScorePlay signs deals with some of the biggest organizations in sports, and every one of them starts with a contract. We are hiring a Commercial Contracts Counsel to own that: redlines, negotiations, signatures, the whole thing. You work directly with Lou, our General Counsel, and are the first point of contact for Sales on contracts.

What you will do

1. Contracts

  • You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries.

  • Sales comes to you when a deal is stuck on terms, and your job is to unstick it: fast turnaround, pragmatic fallbacks, and the judgement to know when a point is worth holding.

  • You partner with Sales, Finance, RevOps and Customer Success so contract terms match how the deal is actually priced, booked and delivered.

  • You take a share of vendor and partner agreements alongside Lou, split based on what is moving and where you want to build depth.

2. Tools, processes and enablement

  • We use AI heavily in contract work: drafting, first-pass reviews, summarizing counterparty terms. We want someone who genuinely enjoys this and keeps looking for a smarter way to handle the repetitive part.

  • Our legal playbook is young. You execute it, then you help Lou refine it with what you see in real negotiations.

3. Privacy and security

  • You contribute to customer security, privacy and vendor due-diligence questionnaires, and to DPA and international transfer questions. The heart of the role is contracts, with room to grow into broader compliance work if that interests you.

What we are looking for

  • You know commercial contracts inside out. 3 to 5 years of experience, most of it in-house, with contracts at the core of what you did.

  • You work autonomously. Give you an MSA or a set of customer redlines and you come back with a position, a fallback and a recommendation.

  • You ship fast. A solid answer today beats a perfect one on Friday, and you're comfortable making the call at 80% certainty.

  • You're resourceful. When something is unclear, you dig, you ask, you find a way, rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You like helping people win. Supporting a Sales team means being responsive, available, and genuinely happy when a deal signs because of your work.

  • You're excited by AI. You already use it in your legal work, or you can't wait to, and you keep looking for smarter ways to handle the repetitive parts.

What’s fun about this role

  • You negotiate international contracts with some of the biggest names in sports: clubs, leagues, federations and broadcasters on every continent.

  • As our first commercial counsel, you own your function and you're the main partner of the Sales team on both sides of the Atlantic.

  • You sit in sales calls with senior stakeholders at major sports organizations, on deals worth USD 50k to 500k a year. When a deal closes, you're usually one of the key players who made it work.

  • Small team, short loops. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table, build playbooks, experiment with AI and new tools, and learn a ton along the way.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

About the Role
We're hiring Linkup's first SDR/BDR, a hybrid pipeline-generation role covering both sides of the funnel: qualifying inbound signups and running structured outbound into our priority segments (AI-native companies, GTM tooling providers, enterprise and regulated accounts).
You'll work closely with our VP Sales, picking accounts, drafting outbound, and partnering with AEs to turn interest into qualified pipeline. High ownership, fast feedback loop.

What You'll Do

  • Research target accounts and draft personalized multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone) for founder-led and AE-assisted outbound

  • Monitor and pre-qualify inbound signups against our ICP (AI-native, GTM tooling, enterprise), then route to the right AE

  • Support first-touch qualification alongside AEs, learning our lead framework (ICP fit, pain, volume, timing, right entry point) as you go

  • Keep every touch logged in Attio

  • Help tune outbound messaging and channels as we scale campaigns across segments


Why This Role Matters
This is the first dedicated pipeline-generation hire at Linkup. Get it right and it compounds into every AE's quota.

You're a Great Fit If You

  • Have 0 to 2 years in SDR/BDR, or a first job out of a fast-paced, competitive environment (sales, consulting, we care about drive more than tenure)

  • Are comfortable with high-volume outbound and don't wait to be told what to do

  • Write clean, direct, non-generic outreach, no template-speak

  • Are curious about AI/agents and can hold a real conversation with a technical buyer, even without an engineering background

  • Want ownership fast, this role works closely with sales leadership, not layers of management

Our Stack
Attio (CRM), LemList (outbound), Slack, Notion, Apollo/Sales Navigator (prospecting), Snitcher (visitor ID), RB2B

About Linkup
Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

jobs.title: Research Engineer — Vision & Perception
jobs.description:
About us

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in our physical AI.

Our vision

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment.

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

The role

We are hiring Research Scientists in Vision & Perception to design the perception stack that makes our robots understand their environment well enough to act in it reliably. Your work will define how our robots see the world, what they recognize, how robustly, and from how little data.

Industrial environments are visually complex, varied, and unforgiving: changing lighting, cluttered scenes, novel objects, and a hard requirement to work in production without supervision. The perception layer has to deliver the spatial and semantic understanding required for learned manipulation policies to succeed, across the many tasks, objects, and sites we will deploy on. Hitting our one-hour demonstration-to-deployment target depends directly on perception methods that work robustly out of the box, with minimal site-specific tuning.

This is a research role focused on shipping algorithms into a real product. We are an early-stage company and do not publish at this stage. You will work in close collaboration with the Robot Learning and Integration teams to ensure the methods you develop run on real robots, in real factories.

Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype, and evaluate perception algorithms for robotic manipulation — object recognition, segmentation, pose estimation, scene understanding, and related areas

  • Advance our internal state of the art in perception for embodied agents, with a focus on robustness and data efficiency

  • Run rigorous experiments on real robots, and contribute to the data, evaluation, and infrastructure needed to do so (we will support you in ramping up on robotics if your background is primarily in vision)

  • Translate research prototypes into perception components robust enough to ship as part of our product

  • Collaborate with the Robot Learning and Integration teams to move research from prototype to production

  • Help shape the long-term research agenda of the company

The team

The engineering team is organized around three focus areas with multiple contributors each: Integration, Vision & Perception (this role), and Robot Learning. Early hires will help shape the research agenda, engineering practices, hiring, and culture.

Required qualifications

  • PhD or MSc in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, or a closely related field, from a leading research lab or strong experience in research environments

  • Track record of published research at top venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS, or equivalent

  • Demonstrated research expertise in computer vision or machine perception — object recognition, segmentation, pose estimation, scene understanding, 3D perception, or representation learning for vision

  • Strong Python skills and fluency with PyTorch

  • Hands-on experience training, evaluating, and debugging modern vision systems

  • Professional proficiency in English (internal working language)

Preferred qualifications

The strongest candidates will combine deep research expertise with experience across several of the following:

  • 3D vision — depth estimation, geometric reasoning, point cloud processing, or 3D scene reconstruction

  • Perception for robotic manipulation, including grasping and interaction

  • Experience working with real robots (any platform — humanoids, arms, mobile bases)

  • Postdoctoral experience, or research positions in industry labs or top academic groups

  • A history of translating research into deployed systems

What we offer

  • A clear, ambitious research mission with measurable real-world impact

  • A diverse fleet of advanced robots, including humanoids, on which to run your research

  • Research that ships: your algorithms run on real machines in real factories

  • Tight collaboration with engineering teams that take your work to production

  • Significant ownership of the research agenda as an early member of the team

  • A focused, technically strong team and a serious engineering culture

  • English-speaking working environment, no French required

  • Fair compensation + equity

About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role

We are looking for a talented Head of Data, deeply passionate about algorithms, data science, data-engineering and data-driven decisions, transforming raw data into clear actionable business insights, who will play a key role in the development of BeReal.

  • Tackle strategic and operational challenges by analyzing large and complex datasets

  • Enable product teams to independently navigate Amplitude dashboards and make informed decisions

  • Provide actionable recommendations from A/B tests to shape the product roadmap

  • Build and scale a robust data infrastructure that addresses both business intelligence and data science needs

  • Lead and mentor a team of Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and Data Analysts

Our stack

  • Infra: GCP, BigQuery, Spanner

  • ETL: Airflow, DBT

  • Product Analytics: Amplitude

  • Data visualisation: Hex, Tableau

Profile

  • 8+ years in data (analysis, engineering, or science), ideally with time spent across more than one of them

  • Track record of delivering fast in a high-tempo environment, with a bias toward results over process

  • Hands-on experience modeling and analyzing high-volume, user-level data

  • Proven history of shipping data science projects into production — not just prototypes

  • Hands-on experience building with modern AI: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, or AI-assisted analytics pipelines

  • Genuine curiosity about where AI is heading, and a habit of staying current with new models, tools, and techniques — and a clear point of view on which ones are worth adopting

  • Experience designing and interpreting complex A/B tests, ideally for mobile apps

  • Advanced command of statistical methods and tooling

  • Ability to explain complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike

  • Fluent in French and English

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% borne by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family 100% borne by Voodoo

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

jobs.title: Staff iOS Engineer, Media Foundations - BeReal
jobs.description:
About BeReal

At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role

We are looking for a Staff iOS Camera & Video Engineer to join BeReal and work on one of the most critical parts of our product: the camera experience.

You will build and improve the capture, image, and video pipelines behind BeReal's core flows — including multi-camera capture, instant capture, front/back video composition, and media quality.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working close to Apple's media APIs, solving real-time performance challenges, and delivering a fast, reliable, high-quality experience.


What you will do:

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance camera and video features on iOS.

  • Own and improve parts of our AVFoundation camera stack: capture sessions, devices, formats, frame rates, exposure, and device capabilities.

  • Build and optimize real-time image and video processing pipelines.

  • Improve capture quality, latency, stability, and smoothness across supported iPhone models.

  • Work on multi-camera flows, front/back video composition, video encoding, media export, and audio/video synchronization.

  • Optimize CPU, GPU, memory, battery usage, thermal behaviour, buffer allocation, and multithreaded processing.

  • Investigate device-specific and iOS-version-specific behaviour, and propose pragmatic technical trade-offs.

  • Work closely with iOS engineers, product, design, backend, and data teams.

  • Contribute directly to the codebase and raise engineering standards around media performance and reliability.

Profile

  • 6+ years of iOS experience, including strong hands-on work on camera, video, or media-heavy features.

  • Deep expertise with AVFoundation and iOS camera APIs: AVCaptureSession, AVCaptureDevice, video outputs, capture formats, frame rates, exposure, and device configuration.

  • Strong experience designing and optimizing real-time camera, image, and video pipelines, with a solid understanding of media formats, encoding, buffer management, and capture quality and performance constraints.

  • Strong performance mindset: CPU/GPU usage, memory, battery, thermal constraints, multithreading, and minimising buffer copies.

  • Comfortable with iOS profiling tools such as Instruments, Time Profiler, Allocations, and Metal System Trace.

  • Strong Swift skills. Experience with Metal, Core Image, or lower-level Apple APIs is a plus.

  • Autonomous, pragmatic, and comfortable solving complex hardware/software limitations.


Bonus:

  • Experience with multi-camera capture or front/back video composition.

  • Experience with Metal or GPU-accelerated image processing.

  • Experience in consumer social, gaming, creative tools, or another real-time mobile product.

Our Stack

  • iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, Swift Concurrency, SPM, MVVM

  • Media: AVFoundation, Core Video, Core Image, Metal

  • Ops: GitHub

  • Android: Kotlin, Compose, Coroutines, Room, gRPC

  • Backend: Go, Node.js (NestJS, Nx, TypeScript)

  • Infrastructure: GCP, GKE, Firebase

  • Data: Amplitude, Tableau

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • €1,000 annual budget for attending tech conferences and professional events

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

 

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly driven Strategic Account Executive to join our growing sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the full sales cycle, building strong relationships with enterprise clients, and driving revenue growth.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Enterprise Sales Execution - Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing enterprise-level deals.

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas in a B2B environment.

  • Ability to analyze customer needs and align them with the right solutions.

  • Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

Kandou is redefining AI infrastructure through innovative interconnect technologies that significantly reduce power consumption while maintaining high bandwidth and ultra-low latency. Our mission is to make AI systems more scalable, efficient, and accessible.

 

Today we have one internship position available for max 6 months, in our Advanced R&D, for MSc students in the following area :

 

Analog Design Intern

 

Internship Background

Modern computing systems increasingly rely on high-speed serial interfaces to transfer large volumes of data between processors, memory devices, and accelerator chips. Simultaneous bidirectional (SBD) signalling enables both ends of a copper channel to transmit and receive data concurrently over the same physical medium, offering a promising path toward higher bandwidth efficiency without increasing the number of interconnects.

 

Project Objectives

The objective of this internship is to investigate circuit and signal-processing techniques that enable simultaneous bidirectional communication over wideband copper serial links. The student will explore methods for separating the locally transmitted signal from the incoming signal while maintaining high data rates and robust link performance.

Specific goals may include:

  • Reviewing the state of the art in simultaneous bidirectional and full-duplex wireline communication systems;

  • Developing behavioural models of wideband copper channels and transceiver architectures;

  • Studying self-interference cancellation techniques in the analog and/or digital domains;

  • Evaluating the impact of channel impairments, mismatch, and non-idealities on link performance;

  • Designing and simulating key building blocks using Python or circuit-level CAD tools;

  • Assessing achievable data rates, energy efficiency, and implementation complexity.

 

Expected Outcomes

At the end of the internship, the student is expected to:

  • Gain hands-on experience in the design and analysis of high-speed wireline communication systems;

  • Develop simulation models for simultaneous bidirectional serial links;

  • Quantify the benefits and challenges associated with full-duplex operation over copper channels;

  • Present the obtained results in a technical report and oral presentation.

 

Depending on the progress and interests of the student, the work may lead to conference or journal publication opportunities.

 

Desired Background

The project is suitable for motivated Master's students in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Communications Engineering, or Computer Engineering.

 

Preferred qualifications:

This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

Context

Cradle helps global biotech and biopharma leaders design radically better proteins from next-generation biologics to high-efficiency enzymes powered by cutting-edge generative AI.

As a Global Account Executive, you’ll lead strategic engagements with some of the world’s most influential R&D organizations, owning key relationships and driving multi-million-dollar partnerships in Europe.

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, ML, engineering, and customer success teams to shape proposals and execute on high-impact, technically complex projects.

  • Act as the voice of the market, surfacing customer feedback and strategic insights to directly inform product direction and roadmap priorities.

  • Build a powerful personal brand in the biotech and AI-for-science space, attending global events, engaging with scientists and executives, and establishing yourself as a trusted advisor in the field.

  • Shape how we sell, improving playbooks, sales processes, and materials as we scale with the freedom to reimagine how enterprise sales is done in a science-driven startup.

In a team that’s thinking big and growing fast, there are few limits to this role. You’ll be expected to operate with ownership, urgency, and creativity and rewarded accordingly.

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where guidance turns intent into a flyable path at speed. It takes a mission objective or a waypoint, produces the reference, and drives the aircraft along it. It is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software.

As a Flight Guidance & Motion Planning Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own motion planning, trajectory generation, and guidance laws, consuming imperfect, delayed inputs from the estimator and the perception pipeline and handing references to the control loop. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from optimization-based planning to learned and differentiable approaches, and decide what holds up at high speed.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Motion Planning: Plan dynamically feasible paths onboard, including obstacle avoidance, replanning as the situation changes, and perception-aware planning.

  • Trajectory Generation: Turn those paths into feasible references under airframe and actuator limits, handed cleanly to the control loop.

  • Guidance Laws: Design the laws that steer the aircraft along the reference and hold it there.

  • Interfaces & Perception Coupling: Own the input contracts for the ego-state from Navigation and the perception pipeline, and handle their latency, rate, and dropout, including behavior when an input drops.

  • Mode & Failsafe Logic: Across cruise, loiter, and approach, including lost-link behavior.

  • Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, robotics, GNC, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Motion Planning & Trajectory: Proven experience with onboard motion planning, trajectory generation, and tracking, and with guidance laws on flying platforms.

  • Perception-Coupled Control: Hands-on experience closing a control loop on a perception output, handling latency and dropout.

  • Learning-Based Methods: Familiarity with learning-based planning or guidance and simulation-based training, with the judgment to weigh it against classical approaches.

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

What you'll own

  • One quality management system across both entities — a common QMS covering Nyon and Houston, including the path to ISO 9001 certification in the US and alignment with what is already established in Switzerland.

  • Equivalence between sites. A single set of product specifications, control plans, inspection criteria, and acceptance standards, with a defined process for how any change is applied at both sites rather than one.

  • In-process quality for fuel cell stack production at both locations, including the process controls that matter most in stack assembly — cleanliness and contamination control, leak testing, torque and compression control, and alignment.

  • Supplier quality for a shared global supply base, working with Supply Chain on qualification, audits, first article inspection, part submission, and ongoing performance, with one qualification standard regardless of which site a supplier serves.

  • Quality oversight of contract manufacturing and assembly partners building balance of plant and containerized systems on our behalf in both regions — audits, quality agreements, source inspection, and acceptance criteria.

  • Nonconformance and corrective action across both sites, including NCR and CAPA processes and structured problem solving, with findings at one site systematically applied at the other.

  • Traceability and product records — a common lot genealogy model from raw material through stack serial to delivered system, and the test and inspection data that supports warranty, certification, and customer acceptance, held consistently across both entities.

  • Certification across regions, working with external certification partners on the standards applicable to stationary hydrogen power systems in Europe and the US, authority having jurisdiction approvals, and marine classification where relevant.

  • Quality culture on both floors, including operator training, work instruction discipline, and establishing the habits in Houston that are already proven in Nyon, as US headcount grows quickly.

  • Building the US quality capability, defining what needs to sit on the ground in Houston versus what is run centrally from Nyon, and recruiting into it as volumes grow.

What we're looking for

Core experience

  • Owning quality across more than one manufacturing site, ideally in more than one country, with a demonstrated ability to hold two sites to genuinely the same standard from a distance.

  • Establishing or substantially rebuilding a quality function, including authoring a quality management system rather than administering an existing one.

  • Hands-on in-process and incoming quality in a production setting, with real familiarity with control plans, inspection methods, measurement systems, and process capability.

  • Supplier quality experience, including auditing suppliers and holding them to standard.

  • Structured problem solving and root cause analysis, with a track record of permanently closing out recurring defects.

  • Working knowledge of product certification processes and the evidence they require, ideally in energy, power equipment, or another regulated product category. Exposure to both European and US regimes is a strong advantage.

  • The judgment to know which controls are essential at low volume and which can wait, and the confidence to hold a quality position under schedule pressure.

  • Comfort working across time zones and influencing a site you are not physically based at, including building quality capability remotely.

Especially compelling

  • Fuel cell, battery cell, or similar electrochemical assembly experience.

  • Experience with cleanliness-critical or contamination-sensitive assembly processes.

  • Experience supporting a technology transfer between sites or countries, and establishing quality at the receiving end.

  • Experience qualifying and auditing contract manufacturers or system integrators.

  • Startup or scale-up experience as an early hire during hyper-growth.

  • Experience working between Europe and the US, and with US codes and certification practice in particular. French is useful but not required.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, calibrated to the market and discussed directly with you.

  • Relocation support to Nyon, Switzerland.

  • The opportunity to build EHG's global quality function during a defining phase of hyper-growth.

Note: Swiss work authorization or eligibility is required for this role, along with the ability to travel to the United States.

About the Role

Summary

Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups.

 

We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line.

 

This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written.   • Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release.

  • Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding.

  • Own inbound product direction for your area.   • Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write.

  • Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release.

  • Validate before you specify.   • Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises.   • Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content.

  • Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end.

  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface.

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team.

  • Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter.

  • Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually.

  • Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is.

  • Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations.

  • Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it.

  • Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform.

  • Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers.

  • Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security.

  • Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls.

  • Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction.

  • Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Quantitative Analyst Intern

As a Quantitative Analyst Intern, you will support our team in analyzing trading and proprietary data, and helping produce quantitative models that drive the decision making behind our quantitative execution offerings. You will assist in producing quantitative signals, impact models, and analyze Talos unique trading datasets to support improvements of the trading products and beyond.

You will work alongside experienced team members, including product owners, quantitative analysts, and managers who will provide guidance and mentorship. jobs.title: Senior Transfer Pricing Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Baue unsere Transfer-Pricing-Strukturen für die nächste Wachstumsphase auf.

Black Semiconductor wächst international und baut seine Finance-Organisation für die nächste Wachstumsphase weiter aus. Dabei schaffen wir heute die Tax- und Transfer-Pricing-Strukturen, die wir für unsere weitere internationale Entwicklung benötigen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du nicht einfach bestehende Strukturen – Du gestaltest sie mit. Du verantwortest zentrale Transfer-Pricing-Themen, begleitest unsere internationale Tax Compliance und entwickelst Strukturen weiter, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren.

Warum diese Rolle?

Transfer Pricing mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unsere Transfer-Pricing-Strukturen und entwickelst diese im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion weiter.

Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du gestaltest Strukturen, Prozesse und Standards aktiv mit und schaffst die Grundlage für ein skalierbares internationales Tax-Setup.

Internationale Perspektive: Du begleitest den Aufbau unserer internationalen Gesellschaften und entwickelst die steuerlichen Strukturen für unsere weitere Expansion mit.

Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst Deine fachliche Expertise direkt einbringen, bestehende Strukturen hinterfragen und pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln.

Impact & Ownership: Deine Arbeit schafft belastbare Tax- und Transfer-Pricing-Strukturen für die internationale Entwicklung von Black Semiconductor.

Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zu einer Teamlead-Rolle.

Scale-up mit anspruchsvollen Tax-Themen: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit internationalem Steuerrecht, Transfer Pricing und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Über uns

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Deine Aufgaben

Transfer Pricing: Du verantwortest zentrale Transfer-Pricing-Themen und entwickelst unsere Strukturen und Dokumentation im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion weiter.

Tax Compliance: Du stellst die steuerliche Compliance unserer internationalen Unternehmensgruppe sicher und koordinierst die relevanten Themen mit externen Beratern und Behörden.

Internationaler Strukturaufbau: Du begleitest den Aufbau unserer internationalen Gesellschaften und gestaltest die dafür notwendigen steuerlichen und Intercompany-Strukturen mit.

Zusammenarbeit & Ownership: Du arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO, Geschäftsführung und relevanten externen Partnern zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise dort ein, wo fachliche Tiefe und Hands-on-Umsetzung gefragt sind.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Transfer Pricing

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der internationalen Tax Compliance

  • Erfahrung mit internationalen Gesellschaftsstrukturen und deren steuerlichen Anforderungen

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude daran, Strukturen selbstständig aufzubauen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir Dir bieten

Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams.

Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.

Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen.

Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.

Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du Dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.

Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.

Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. Schließ Dich unserem Team an und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das in der Branche etwas bewirken will.
